svg.title: Avionics Panel: GNS 530/430 with the KAP 140, cheat sheet
svg.text: KAP 140 altitude: 100 ft, quick turn 1000 ft
kHz (COM, NAV); ADF 1 kHz, quick turn 10 kHz
COM, NAV, ADF (green light: off, on, blinks); held
outer picks a digit, inner sets it; then VFR: IDENT
⇧ = after a tap on SHIFT (amber light). Unit 2: SHIFT, HOME (white light). "does nothing": this profile sends nothing for it.
